decisions.reason: Step 3.2 used intrinsic compactness of the closed set Sigma to extract finitely many ambient-open W members without the required ambient criterion. Added dependency and fact F5 citing claim 2 of lem-compactness-of-a-subspace-is-ambient, and used it explicitly. The shrinking, repeated-tuple meet covers and N/M finite descents remain sound without AC; the Statement is unchanged.

Original F5/step 3.3 claimed independence for arbitrary resolutions although the cited theorem only covers injective resolutions. A natural Godement cohomology isomorphism alone does not identify connecting maps. Repaired F5 and added exact-triple extensions into a split injective horseshoe, identified the comparison by canonical acyclic-resolution dimension shifts, then used naturality of complex boundaries. The original Statement, canonical comparison and AC assumption remain unchanged.

The second remark confused vanishing for one fixed finite cover with vanishing in the refinement limit. The cover consisting of the whole space has order one for any space, so that inference would incorrectly force all positive-degree Cech cohomology to vanish. Replaced it by fixed-cover vanishing plus the required cofinal-family condition. Steps 1.3, 2.1, 2.2 and 3.1 already use that condition correctly, and the Statement is unchanged.

Compatible refinement: retained the finite shrinking induction, repeated-value meet covers and two finite descents. Added F5 citing published lem-compactness-of-a-subspace-is-ambient claim 2 for the finite ambient-open subcover of Sigma in step 3.2. The W sets are ambient-open because their parent intersection is open. No AC was added.

Cech comparison: original F5 overclaimed the published long-exact-sequence interface. F12 now cites the degreewise-split projective horseshoe and passage to the opposite abelian category, rather than claiming a split row from the shorter injective-horseshoe Statement. Step 2.3 proves extension of exact triples into split injective triples and builds the strict comparison recursively using DC. Step 1.7 checks the canonical Godement identification by the actual dimension-shifting construction of thm-acyclic-resolution-theorem-for-right-derived-functors and uses lem-comparison-map-from-an-exact-complex-into-an-injective-resolution for homotopy independence. Step 3.3 then compares connecting maps by a morphism of short exact complexes. Complete relevant proofs of Stacks 09V2 and 013T were consulted; their hypotheses and boundary constructions were checked. No new item is needed.

Dimension bound: corrected only the second remark. Step 1.3 proves fixed-cover vanishing; steps 2.1, 2.2 and 3.1 use cofinal order-bounded refinements. The mesh supplier uses the original transported Euclidean metric; stars cover with multiplicity bounded by support-simplex size. Steps 3.2 and 4.1 use the supplied open-extension compact-support identity and equality of compact-support and ordinary sections on a compact ambient space.
